MECHANISM (pre-registered, mirroring the v171 CNV plumbing): at the SAME terminal slot where _cnv_veto is called (after merge/NMS/PostTighten/classify/curve-correction/MIL-sanity/conf-gate/ECE/EUBC/Q-score/BUE/CBT — count frozen), load model_snh.json, compute the 16 features for the current video from the pipeline's OWN cached signals (mil_scores, 13 cat curves, normal curve, motion_energy — the same signal families _cnv_stage1_bundle already reads at that slot), standardize with the saved scaler, P(normal)=sigmoid(w·x+b); if P(normal) >= tau veto ALL of the video's detections (confidence := 0.0, detection KEPT, count-frozen index-aligned, ONE-SIDED — never adds/moves/re-ranks). Markers: one [SNH-FIRE] per vetoed detection in the EXACT restore_pre_marker conf format (vid=<stem> ... t=<ts>.2f-<te>.2f ... conf=<old>.4f->0.0000) + exactly one unconditional [SNH-VID] per video on EVERY path incl. early-return-normal and 0-detection paths (FM17, mirroring _cnv_log_early_return). SNH_FORCE_FIRE=1 dev-only self-test hook (never set in committed runs). Flag snh_veto default OFF, CLI in run.py AND batch_evaluate.py. ADJUDICATION (the v171 proven path, NO new bootstrap code): analysis_bootstrap_ab.py --new <dir> --paired-log <run.log> --marker SNH-FIRE --paired-mode conf — EXACT paired arm-OFF rebuild, zero cross-run VLM noise. PROMOTION GATES (pre-registered, same as v17): paired mAP delta >= -0.003 AND abs mAP >= 0.16454 AND Normal-video FA-rate relative reduction >= 25% AND <= 1 GT-overlapping (IoU>=0.1) detection vetoed. Committed pipeline = v137 + BUE + CBT + CBT-recal (all default-ON, full-290 ~0.173, v160_full 0.17254); cgr/ccr/cnv/kfd/tcp all default-OFF and stay so. Concurrency 2. QUEUE DISCIPLINE: another session's batch_evaluate may still be running — EVERY batch_evaluate launch in this session (incl. self-test smokes) must first verify no other batch_evaluate process is running, and sleep-poll until clear (up to ~90 min) — never run two evals concurrently (16 GB machine, owner-diagnosed swap thrash). NONE of the 10 banned families; this is judged on the FA-rate objective with mAP only as a non-inferiority constraint — NOT Normal-FP-for-mAP (banned 9).
